Chapter 421: Chapter 2: Special Life Groups (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 421: Chapter 2: Special Life Groups (Subscription Requested)

“Alright.”

“There is no need to inform me about your conversation with the Supreme Being.”

“The reason I called you here is to consider your overseeing duties in the star domain that lies ahead.”

The Chikun Star Lord looked down at Lin Yuan and began to speak.

As a teacher, when a disciple is about to travel far and manage a distant star domain, it’s natural to make some arrangements.

“Your strength is much greater than that of your senior brother; in this respect, I am not worried,” a smile appeared on the face of the Chikun Star Lord.

...

Being able to advance to the newly reached Eighth Layer and possess combat power close to the late stages or peak of the Eighth Layer is extremely rare in the entire Annan Star Alliance.

And if you consider those under a hundred years old, the Human Civilization Alliance can hardly find a few.

The Chikun Star Lord was unaware that the true age of Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will was over a thousand years old, nor did he know that the evolutionary path Lin Yuan had walked was one he had blazed from nothingness.

Compared to being a thousand years old, blazing a Martial Path Evolutionary Path is even more unthinkable.

Xia Qin, the Evolver, even ranked Lin Yuan among the top ten to twenty geniuses in the history of human civilization.

“But in a strange star domain, relying solely on strength is not enough; you also must have trustworthy subordinates,” thought the Chikun Star Lord.

Two figures appeared not far away.

These two figures, one with dark red skin and the other with sharp ears and green eyes, were obviously not human Evolvers.

“Star Lord.”

The two figures bowed slightly towards the Chikun Star Lord.

“From today onwards, you will follow my disciple,” pointed out the Chikun Star Lord towards Lin Yuan and said.

“Yes.”

The two figures walked up to Lin Yuan.

“They?”

Lin Yuan’s expression subtly changed.

From close sensing, both figures were Eighth Layer beings, not just newly advanced ones.

“These two, as servants of mine, are not human Evolvers; one is called Hongpi, mid-Eighth Layer, and the other is called Lvyan, late-Eighth Layer,” he explained.

“There are no issues regarding their loyalty.”

“With their aid, you will at least not be overwhelmed in the Fringe Starfield,” the Chikun Star Lord said casually.

“Teacher… this is too precious…”

Lin Yuan said earnestly.

Having two loyally devoted Eighth Layer beings from different species under one’s command was simply…

Lin Yuan couldn’t even describe his feelings, from the perspective of Merit Points, two Eighth Layer beings from another species were worth two million Merit Points.

In fact, the real value of living Eighth Layer beings exceeded a million Merit Points, as an Eighth Layer being if long stationed in battlefields of different species could amass that many Merit Points over tens of thousands of years.

Not to mention other incomes and gains.

“Why the formalities with me?”

“With my current strength, do you think I need them?”

The Chikun Star Lord glared at Lin Yuan.

“But…”

Lin Yuan felt somewhat conflicted.

Although as an undefeated being of the Eighth Layer, the Chikun Star Lord indeed did not need mid or late Eighth Layer subordinates,

not needing them didn’t mean they held no value, casually placing those two Eighth Layer beings in battlefields could earn the Chikun Star Lord immense wealth over time.

Having two Eighth Layer beings work for him was extravagantly luxurious.

“No more ‘buts.'”

“Just take them and keep them,” the Chikun Star Lord waved his hand and said, “Go back now, if there are any issues, just contact me in the Virtual World.”

“Thank you, Teacher.”

Lin Yuan bowed earnestly to the Chikun Star Lord.

Although Lin Yuan possessed both Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit, the Yin Spirit needed to be accelerated under the Eternal Spatial Rift in the Battlefields of Different Species to accumulate World-Breaking Origin Force.

The Yang Spirit stayed at the Chikun Main Star for protection.

Relying solely on his true self, many tasks would be hindered in the Fringe Starfield.

But with these two Eighth Layer subordinates, it was different now; many things could be simply instructed.

…

Thirteen Peaks.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

Hongpi and Lvyan, the two Eighth Layer beings of different species, stood in front of Lin Yuan.

“Introduce yourselves,” Lin Yuan said.

“Peak Master, I am called Hongpi,” said the dark red-skinned being.

“My strength is at the mid-Eighth Layer, I follow the Rules of Fire and Space, and my inner world spans 9,800 li,” Hongpi quickly stated.

“Peak Master, I am Lvyan,” said the being with green eyes beside him, “I am at the late-Eighth Layer, proficient in the Rule of Life, late-Eighth Layer, my inner world spans 32,000 li.”

“If the Peak Master sustains any injuries, as long as the soul has not completely collapsed, I dare not say I can save you, but at least I can ensure you won’t die for a short time,” Lvyan said.

“Rule of Life?”

Lin Yuan took another look at Lvyan.

The Rule of Life, along with the Space and Time Rules, is one of the foundational rules of the Cosmic Starry Skies.

Currently, Lin Yuan’s understanding of the Rule of Life was just a bit more than elementary.

“I understand,”

Lin Yuan nodded.

“Normally, you will stay in my inner world.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the two beings, his thoughts shifted, and he absorbed them into his inner world.

In his inner world, Lin Yuan was akin to a creator god, capable of effortlessly mobilizing the power of an entire world.

“This time… Teacher has really helped me tremendously,”

Lin Yuan thought silently.

With the assistance of Hongpi and Lvyan, Lin Yuan felt much relieved.

To establish a star domain and govern billions of citizens involves aspects in every direction; having two capable assistants relieved him of so much concern.

…

Half a day later.

“Master, your custom-ordered Layer A cosmic spacecraft has arrived,” the voice of the intelligent assistant rang in Lin Yuan’s ears.

“The spacecraft has arrived,”

Lin Yuan’s spirits lifted slightly.

The cosmic spacecraft Lin Yuan had purchased before were the most ordinary standard ones, only barely passable in performance.

The Wormhole Shuttles it carried out were incomparable in both range and cooldown time to those of B-layer and A-layer spacecraft.
